headline: Wednesday close: twelve stocks face GDP, PCE and ECB tests

macro.dd: The twelve company moves below come solely from validated completed Twelve Data daily bars. Fed policy and after-hours earnings provide context, but neither a sector headline nor a price change proves causation.

entries.happened: AAPL closed the completed October 28, 2026 NYSE session at $343.83, -0.94% versus the prior close of $347.10. The session ranged from $343.52 to $347.18, with volume of 35,595,700 shares versus a trailing average of 39,082,470. No dated company-specific event was verified in the sources checked for this edition.
entries.why: The measured down move is evidence about trading, not a diagnosis of the business. For AAPL, the next investment test is whether operating results, cash generation and competitive position support the valuation implied by the share price as rates and AI capital spending evolve. Volume relative to its trailing average provides a participation check, but it cannot identify who traded or why. Investors should separate the observed bar from any hypothesis about headlines.
